## Checklist (new plugin listings)

- [ ] Plugin repo is public and has a clear README.
- [ ] Plugin repo has at least one tagged release.
- [ ] Plugin repo has an OSI-approved license.
- [ ] Entry includes `name`, `source`, and `description`.
- [ ] `description` is under ~140 characters.
- [ ] `marketplace.json` is valid JSON (`python -m json.tool` or `jq` passes).
- [ ] Naming is descriptive and does not collide with existing entries.
